note: INITIAL AUTHORING, NOT MEASURED. Favorite-car upgrade paths for all 18 models (Addendum 02 section 8, D206). PI values are the Core engine-free ESTIMATE; demand PIs are initial targets that the Unity handling harness, real driving and the benchmark calibration must confirm or revise. Builds use only parts the shop offers by the step's act.

economy.note: Starter grant 12,000 + tutorial 3,000. Ordinary campaign races paid by Core Economy.Compute (expected seconds, placements 1.35/1.20/1.10/1.00, clean 1.05 every third attempt, Hard 1.35), first clears once, lost attempts still paid as legal finishers. Normal ~29% and Hard ~47% of attempts fail qualification. 10% of every payout is reserved for optional cosmetics/course purchases. No challenge cash, no Freeplay grinding.

bands.note: Act I opening (D cap 299): stock starters are enough; first grip is optional.
Act I C-cap stages and the first lieutenant: fundamentals (tyres, brakes, usable gearing) expected.
Act II (B cap 699): balanced T2 grip and chassis.
Act IV (uncapped): a well-developed car; selective T3. Set at what the budget-feasible starter path reaches when Act IV opens.
Hard D-cap stages: a class-legal preset from owned parts, tuned near the cap.
Hard A-cap stages: selective T4 where the economy allows.
Hard Act IV: the developed favorite car with selective T4, not T4 in every slot.
